description: The forge's curated voice library (backend/services/voice/voice-library.js). Clips are downloaded on demand into the voice data root and checked against sha256 (computed from the file as downloaded by curl from `source`); never committed. pitchHz = median pitch (forge-doors measureClip on the 24 kHz mono decode); pitch = higher when pitchHz >= 165. accent = as the source lists it ('' = the source does not say). register = the speaker's own (the named LibriVox reader or voice actor; the pitch band only where the source names nobody) — two low-pitched women make the pitch band alone a wrong label. words = faster-whisper large-v3 transcripts of the exact file, pinned (an obvious mishearing corrected against the source text).

voices.name: Unmute developer
voices.about: A Kyutai team member's own recording, talking about a map
voices.attribution: Kyutai (unmute-prod-website/developer-1) via kyutai/tts-voices, CC0
voices.words: It shows you where you are, and, to give you a sense of scale, it also has a circle that says 15-minute walk. But what's always bothered me about this is that this circle is a lie.

voices.name: Unmute default
voices.about: The fallback voice of Kyutai's Unmute demo — deliberately a little strange
voices.attribution: Kyutai (unmute-prod-website/default_voice) via kyutai/tts-voices, CC0
voices.words: Something is broken, and the text-to-speech is not working, so this is the default voice that you get, and it sounds kind of strange, so that you can tell that it's broken.
